outer.color_note: Weight including controller 65 kg. Insulated box with heating elements in a separate insulated enclosure (depth 650 mm vs internal 230 mm: the extra depth houses the heater/baffle plenum behind the working space). Left-hinged door with central window. Supported on a frame between the UTM columns; rolls back to park. Separate self-pressurising LN2 Dewar (size not published). Finish colour not published.

stages.name: Working chamber (forced-air, recirculated top and bottom; -150 to 600 C, +/-2 C)
Heater enclosure (insulated, behind baffle; 4.2 kW)
stages.quote: Air is forced over the heating elements located in an insulated enclosure protecting the user and forced into the working chamber area top and bottom.

stages.name: Self-pressurising LN2 Dewar (external, optional sub-zero supply)
stages.quote: Optional sub-zero temperature testing is available via a self-pressurising liquid nitrogen Dewar.

sample_space.shape: rectangular box 240 W x 230 D x 610 H mm, open top and bottom for the UTM pull rods between the machine columns
sample_space.description: Specimen hangs on the testing-machine grips/pull rods passing vertically through the chamber; air enters top and bottom and is drawn back through the centre to the heater baffle. Visible through the 350 x 170 mm door window for non-contact extensometry.

wiring.to: single control thermocouple in the working chamber
wiring.quote: Controller type Eurotherm model 3016 for single thermocouple temperature control configuration.

wiring.from: 230 V single-phase 50 Hz supply via controller
wiring.to: heating elements in insulated enclosure (4.2 kW)

windows.quote: Viewing window is central to door 350mm high by 170mm wide. supports use of non contacting extensometer and deflectometers.

moving_parts.quote: Air is forced over the heating elements ... forced into the working chamber area top and bottom. It is then drawn back through the centre of the chamber, through a baffler to the heating elements and recirculated.
moving_parts.rate: continuous forced-air recirculation (fan speed not published)

moving_parts.quote: Optional sub-zero temperature testing is available via a self-pressurising liquid nitrogen Dewar.
moving_parts.rate: LN2 injected on demand below ambient; flow rate not published

moving_parts.quote: Door is left hinged. Safety interlock operated by door hinge cut heating process when door is opened.
When the chamber is not in use, the chamber can be rolled back and parked clear of the operating area.

notes: Single source: Tinius Olsen product page 'Chamber - (-150 to 600°C)', fetched 2026-10-31, text cached at research/v5/cache/80f05ca6503e9958.txt (Specifications tab lines: temperature -150 to 600 C, thermocouple sample time 62.5 ms/16 Hz, stability +/-2 C, internal 610 H x 240 W x 230 D mm, external 760 H x 350 W x 650 D mm, window 350 x 170 mm, 230 V 50 Hz 4.2 kW, 65 kg incl. controller). Note the page labels dimensions '(WxDxH)' but lists Height/width/depth explicitly; values used as labelled. A separate Tinius Olsen brochure CF0000EN02 (research/v5/cache/b2a50b257353eee1.txt) describes the -70/+300 C family with an 'internal radial fan' and 'triple glazed window' but is a different model, so its numbers were not used. Nothing is cryogenic beyond the LN2 Dewar feed; no vacuum, no cold head, no magnet. Scene: box_on_frame hung between UTM columns, door with tall window on the front, heater plenum at the rear, LN2 Dewar as a separate external vessel.
